layers.name: Ingestion/ECC
layers.responsibility: ingest sources and infer editorial context without owning canon

layers.name: VaERL core
layers.responsibility: semantic source of truth for entities, facts, relationships, evidence, review state

layers.name: Markdown materialization layer
layers.responsibility: editable notes with frontmatter/wikilinks generated from VaERL

layers.name: Graph/index/backlink layer
layers.responsibility: derive graph/search/backlinks from VaERL plus Markdown

layers.name: AI authoring suite
layers.responsibility: line/paragraph rewriting, Character Lab, grounded queries

read_flow: VaERL -> materialized Markdown -> graph/backlink index -> viewer/wiki/editor retrieval
write_flow: author edit -> change event -> VaERL patch proposal -> review/accept -> rebuild projections
graph_rebuild_strategy: incremental rebuild from changed VaERL ids and Markdown links
